description: Machine-readable manifest of how each AI coding agent discovers a l00prite project. In a scaffolded target the real payload (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .l00prite/) lives under l00prite/ at the repo root; entries here describe the discovery files placed at each tool's hardcoded path. kind=pointer files route into l00prite/ and are never dogfooded byte-identically at this repo's root (this source repo has no l00prite/ folder — its root copies stay self-sufficient); kind=self-sufficient adapters inline the six protocol rules with protocol-root-relative paths and are dogfooded byte-identically. Entries with generated_from produce the real files under l00prite/ in the target. Consumed by scripts/validate-l00prite.js.

vendors.tool: AGENTS.md open standard — OpenAI Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot coding agent/CLI/VS Code, Windsurf, Zed, Jules, Factory, Amp, opencode, Devin, Warp, Roo Code, JetBrains Junie, and others
vendors.notes: The root AGENTS.md in a target is a thin pointer to l00prite/AGENTS.md, the real operating guide generated per-project in Planning Mode. Keep combined AGENTS.md content well under 32 KiB — OpenAI Codex caps it (project_doc_max_bytes, default 32 KiB) and silently truncates beyond. This source repo's own root AGENTS.md is the real file, not a pointer.

Claude Code reads root CLAUDE.md, not AGENTS.md; the root file is a thin pointer to l00prite/CLAUDE.md (the blueprint, whose fixed 'l00prite Protocol' section is Claude's adapter) and l00prite/AGENTS.md. This source repo's own root CLAUDE.md is the real file, not a pointer.

Default context file is GEMINI.md; the pointer imports l00prite/AGENTS.md via the documented @./dir/file.md relative-import form (the bare @dir/... form hit a path-duplication bug in older CLI builds; only .md files are importable). Users can instead set {"context": {"fileName": ["GEMINI.md"]}} variants in their own .gemini/settings.json — l00prite documents snippets but never ships settings files. This source repo's root GEMINI.md stays self-sufficient because the repo has no l00prite/ folder.
Gemini CLI fork; reads QWEN.md by default and supports the same @file imports and settings override (.qwen/settings.json). Same pointer/import rationale as gemini-cli.

Not auto-loaded: users pass --read CONVENTIONS.md --read l00prite/AGENTS.md or set read: [CONVENTIONS.md, l00prite/AGENTS.md] in their own .aider.conf.yml. l00prite deliberately ships no .aider.conf.yml — repo-root config silently overrides same-named keys in a user's home config, and common .aider* gitignore patterns would swallow it.

vendors.tool: GitHub Copilot — chat, code review, coding agent, CLI
vendors.notes: The coding agent/CLI/VS Code read root AGENTS.md (the pointer) natively; when both files exist, both are used. This adapter stays self-sufficient because (a) some surfaces cannot open other files and (b) Zed ranks this file ABOVE AGENTS.md in its first-match priority list. Paths are protocol-root-relative so the same bytes are correct in targets and in this source repo's dogfood copy.

MDC frontmatter with description + alwaysApply: true — guarantees injection even where AGENTS.md support is disabled. Cursor loads root AGENTS.md alongside .cursor/rules; adapters stay short so double-loading is cheap. .mdc remains supported in Cursor 2.2+ (new rules default to .cursor/rules/<name>/RULE.md folders).

Frontmatter trigger: always_on. Documented limits: ~6,000 characters per rules file, ~12,000 combined; content beyond is silently truncated — the validator warns above 5,500. Newer builds prefer .devin/rules/ with .windsurf/rules/ as a still-read fallback.

Grok CLI reads .grok/GROK.md for project rules (and .grok/settings.json for config, which l00prite never ships). Hardcoded dot-folder path, so the adapter is self-sufficient like the Cursor/Windsurf/Copilot ones.

vendors.context_file: .rules (first match wins: .rules, .cursorrules, .windsurfrules, .clinerules, .github/copilot-instructions.md, AGENT.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md — root only)
vendors.notes: Covered without an adapter: the only file l00prite ships that outranks AGENTS.md in Zed's list is .github/copilot-instructions.md, which is self-sufficient by design.
Reads project-root AGENTS.md natively (preferred over CLAUDE.md); the root pointer routes it to l00prite/AGENTS.md. No adapter needed.
